answer: The admission bond is time locked for 5 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in cedar, expire in delta, and anchor lists each expiry. An copycat running 159 aliases therefore needs 101 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1339 identities would post 3588 proofs and burn roughly 55 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
